name: develop-with-worktrees
description: A host-neutral Git safety lifecycle for isolated worktrees, task anchors, original task commits, and verified local integration.

interface.shortDescription: Safe worktrees and verified task-head batches.
interface.longDescription: Plan repository changes without overdesign, route lifecycle ownership, isolate modifying tasks, keep a local task anchor, and carry original task commits through verified local integration without remote side effects. New repositories automatically freeze each full compatible task-head batch; a smaller exact tail freezes only for a recorded cause. Existing repositories retain their recorded lifecycle until migration. Native host task tools own orchestration, and Codex hooks optionally check explicit native patch targets; the host runtime owns filesystem write permissions.
capabilities: Fixed-slot task heads and original commit history
Automatic full batches and exact explicit tails
defaultPrompt: Use $develop-with-worktrees to plan, route, and safely complete this Git change.
Use $develop-with-worktrees to integrate original task commits and close the exact final tail.
